title: Add support for ActionLocation (new in Django 6.1)
author: emansije
body_preview: By default, admin actions are available on the change list page only, but [in Django 6.1 a `location` argument was introduced to the `@admin.action` decorator](https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/6.1/ref/contrib/admin/actions/#controlling-where-actions-are-available). It is now possible to add the admin action to the change form.
